question: Which of the following nations retained its ICC T20 Women's World Cup Crown in March 2020?
solution:
The correct option is __**Australia.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The **2020 ICC Women's T20 World Cup **was the** seventh ICC Women's T20 **World Cup tournament.
 
• It was held between 21 February and 8 March 2020 in** Melbourne, Australia**.
 
• The** final took place on International Women's Day**.
 
• **Australia won** the tournament, beating** India by 85 runs.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
